author: Shristi Achar
Surabhi Agarwal
body:
About 50% of AI-led deflation has already been sustained by $30 billion Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) and another half may take place over the next 18 months or so, chief executive K Krithivasan told Shristi Achar & Surabhi Agarwal in an interview. Due to the continuing pressure on companies amid geopolitical strife, TCS is assuming client budgets will not rise. It is, however, banking on customers spending on AI and modernisation. AI

title: AI revenue should offset traditional services deflation: TCS CEO K Krithivasan
